title: Idempotency Key Deduplication on Master Block Order
precondition: Network timeout causes master trading GUI to retry order submission with same `Idempotency-Key`.
expected_result: Second request deduplicated at API gateway; single block executed; zero double-order fan-out.
actual_result: OMS API gateway caches Idempotency-Key headers, deduplicating retried requests and preventing duplicate child fan-outs.
